# EIPIP Notes 

## Next steps

- Gathering wider community feedback on the [proposed changes](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/issues/9332).
- Sam Wilson to finish up the Zola-based EIPs website implementation and create a pull request in April.
- Sam Wilson to include RIPs in the new EIPs website implementation.
- Viwin and Skanda to collaborate on testing the stagnant bot implementation.
- Pooja to reach out to PandaPip for potential help with the stagnant bot testing.
- EIP editors to review and approve the [new PR for adding the proposal builder tool](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9495) to eips.ethereum.org.
- Pooja to schedule the **next EIPIP meeting for April 16th at 14:00 UTC**.

## 1. Discuss Open Issues/PRs and Other Topics

### [Modernize EIPs Platform: Migration from Jekyll](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/issues/9332)
- Discussion initiated by Pooja
- Sam Wilson shared updates on modernizing the EIPs platform, proposing a migration away from Jekyll.
- Concerns were raised regarding the use of TypeScript due to its complexity.
- Sam is working on a separate modernization initiative using the **Zola static site generator** (written in Rust) to reduce build time from 10 minutes to 2 minutes.
- **Action:** Pooja recommended gathering wider community feedback on the proposed changes.
- **Related Discussion:** [EIPs#9115 – Vulnerable Dependencies](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/issues/9115)

### [GitHub Discussions Integration](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/issues/9204)
- The team briefly discussed the proposal of using **GitHub Discussions** as a potential space for asynchronous EIP-related feedback.
- Decision: Stick to [Fellowship of Ethereum Magicians](https://ethereum-magicians.org/) as the main discussion place for EIPs.

### [CI: Switch to `upload-artifact@v4`](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9455)
- Sam is addressing the CI pipeline improvement.
- merged

### [Vulnerable Dependencies in the Repository](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/issues/9115)
- The repository has outdated/vulnerable dependencies.
- Sam noted this is being reviewed and handled offline.

### [New Proposal: Max Blob Flag for Local Builders](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9366)
- The proposal was acknowledged, pending further technical discussion.
- Closed

### [EIPs#9305 – Clarify JSON-RPC in EIP-2294](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9305)
- merged

###  [EIPs#8986 – Fix typo in EIP-1186](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/8986)
- typo fix, merged.

### [EIPs#9314 – Fix spelling errors in CI](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9314)
- will be reviewed async

### [EIPs#9261 – Fix spelling in EIP-1](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9261)
- Sam will handle merging and cleanup tasks.

### [EIPs#9447 – Fix link typo in EIP-1](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9447)
- closed

### Stagnant Bot 
- Viwin (EIPsInsight) gave a presentation on th last call. 
- Shared some developments to fix the issue. Requested support in testing before pushing the codes to production.
- Skanda volunteered to assist with bot-related enhancements.

### Call for Input – Open Issues

#### [EIPIP#381](https://github.com/ethcatherders/EIPIP/issues/381)
- Vulnerability found in the reference implementation.
- Consensus: should not be merged. Alternate path needed for security-critical items.
- Deadline: **March 21, 2025**

#### [EIPIP#376](https://github.com/ethcatherders/EIPIP/issues/376)
- Discussion on whether to allow links to Blockchain Commons standard.
- Sam opposed; 2 editors agreed to oppose, 1 remained neutral.
- Decision: link should not be included.

## 2: Other Discussions & Updates from Past Meetings

### EIP Reviewers – Documentation and Contributions
- Pooja presented [[EIP Reviewers: Survey & Contribution Report](https://hackmd.io/@poojaranjan/EIPReviewersSurveyContributionReport)].
  - Included a [leaderboard](https://eipsinsight.com/Reviewers) of editor/reviewer contributions since 2015.
  - Mapped areas of expertise for editors.
- Recommendations:
  - Increase technical reviews.
  - Make reviewer report public for transparency and onboarding.

## 3: EIPs Insight – Monthly Reporting

### March 2025 Report & Updates

#### Proposal Builder Tool
- Vivin showcased the **dynamic [proposal builder](https://eipsinsight.com/proposalbuilder)**, now supporting:
  - Real-time editing
- A [new PR](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9495) has been opened after closing the previous one due to technical issues.
- **Request:** Editors to review the PR and provide feedback.

#### Updates to "All EIPs" Page
- Page now lists all EIPs in tabular format for improved search and navigation.

#### Stagnant Bot Progress
- Bot now includes:
  - Type checks for required fields
  - Time checks for request field
- Vivin requested help on the **testing side**.
- Pooja encouraged Vivin to join the **Ethereum Cat Herders Discord**.

###  Monthly EIPs Insight Summary
- March 2025 Status:
  - **4 Final EIPs**
  - **9 EIPs in Draft**
  - **2 EIPIPs and 1 EIP in Review**
  - **1 EIP in Last Call**
  - **2 EIPIPs and 2 in Start Stage**

### Update to eips.ethereum.org
- Sam is working on updating the  **page** 
- Will also include RIPs proposals to be shown
- **Action:** Sam to complete redesign and submit PRs in April.

## Scheduling & Closing Notes
- Pooja brought up the conflict with EOF meeting at 15:00 UTC, requested alternate time. 
- The team agreed to move the next meeting to an earlier time to avoid scheduling conflicts.

##  **Next Meeting:** April 16, 2025 – 14:00 UTC
